name: io.github.mgcrea/mcp-apple-voice-memos
title: Apple Voice Memos
description: Read and search Apple Voice Memos recordings and their on-device transcripts, export off by default

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_VOICE_MEMOS_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Register save_recording, which copies a recording's audio into the export folder. Off by default, and the gate decides whether the tool exists at all rather than merely refusing.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_VOICE_MEMOS_EXPORT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where save_recording copies audio. Defaults to ~/Downloads, one of the folders Cadence imports from. Nothing is written outside it.
